subject: general
question: Spot the correct spelling of the study of butterflies & moths.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 2 i.e. Lepidopterology.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lepidopterology** is the correct term that refers to the scientific study of butterflies and moths.
 
• The word is derived from **"Lepido-"** meaning "scale" (referring to the scales on butterfly wings) and **"-pterology"** meaning "study of wings".
 
• It is a specialized branch of entomology (the study of insects).

Correct sentence: *The study of butterflies and moths is called **Lepidopterology**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Lepidopetrology** - Incorrect spelling, does not refer to any scientific study.
 
• **Option 3: Lepidopteralogy** - Incorrect spelling, does not exist as a recognized term.
 
• **Option 4: Lepidopterlogy** - Incorrect spelling, missing "o" in "-pterology".
